svg.title: Technical Architecture of the Cognitive Apprenticeship AI System (CAAIS)
svg.desc: Spacious publication layout of the implemented CAAIS runtime. Solid blue arrows show implemented runtime and data flows. Dashed amber notation shows declared pedagogical handoff semantics in trace metadata, not executable LangGraph edges. Gray dash-dot arrows show optional integrations or the local-development storage alternative.
svg.text: Technical Architecture of the Cognitive Apprenticeship AI System (CAAIS)
Implemented runtime snapshot - learner-facing multi-agent guidance and evidence pipeline
sort A1-A4; visible A1/A2; background A3/A4
all nodes read the same initial request and terminate independently
Privacy: server-derived identity; raw learner text excluded from analytics, xAPI, and telemetry; production fails closed without PostgreSQL
CAAIS implementation snapshot - 30 July 2026 - single Next.js application; agents are graph nodes, not services
Large-canvas vector master - IEEE full-width figure
